info.title: Aruba Central
info.description:
Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code grant) via Aruba Central's own OAuth2 provider.

HPE Aruba Networking Central cloud-managed network platform full API surface, generated from Aruba Central's self-hosted per-instance Swagger 2.0 definitions (not independently fetchable without a live tenant). Operation bodies reflect the adapter-derived request/response shapes extracted from those definitions and have not been hand-cleaned; see aruba_central-latest.json for the hand-curated, vendor-doc-verified common-CRUD subset.

Source: https://developer.arubanetworks.com/central/docs

oauth2AuthCode.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant via Aruba Central's own OAuth2 provider (client ID/secret registered against a Central account, per-region API gateway).
